'''Identity Crisis''' is the 2nd virtual expansion of [[Star Trek CCG 1st Edition]]. It is published by [[The Continuing Committee]] on 5 January 2009. The set consists of 23 dual affiliation cards and 2 triple affiliation cards. These cards are alternate image versions of [[Decipher]] multiple affiliation cards that did not have alternate image versions issued.

==Type Breakdown==
*1 [[:Category:Facility (Star Trek CCG 1E)|Facility]] (1 Cardassian and 1 Federation)
*21 [[:Category:Personnel (Star Trek CCG 1E)|Personnel]] (9 Bajoran, 6 Cardassian, 12 Federation, 9 Ferengi, 1 Klingon, 3 Non-Aligned and 4 Romulan)
*3 [[:Category:Ship (Star Trek CCG 1E)|Ship]] (1 Cardassian, 1 Federation, 2 Klingon and 2 Romulan)

'''NOTE:''' There are 25 Multiple Affiliations cards, thus the totals are higher than the amount of a card type.

==Rarity Breakdown==
*25 [[:Category:Virtual (Star Trek CCG 1E)|Virtual]]
